question:
Select the meaning of the given idiom.

bad blood
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"bad blood"** means hostility or ill feeling between people. (द्वेष या शत्रुता)

 
 
• **Example: **There has been** *bad blood*** between the two families for years.
 
 
 
• **"hostility between people" **refers to a state of **antagonism or unfriendliness **between individuals or groups. (लोगों के बीच शत्रुता)
 
 
• **Example: **The ***hostility*** between the two colleagues was evident in their interactions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct meaning of the given idiom is*** 'hostility between people'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Poor blood circulation **(खराब रक्त परिसंचरण): Refers to inadequate blood flow to different parts of the body.

 
 
• **Example:** He suffers from*** poor blood circulation***, which makes his hands and feet cold.
 
 
 
• **Family of ill-repute **(बदनाम परिवार): Refers to a family that has a bad reputation.
 
 
• **Example: **The Smiths were considered a ***family of ill-repute*** due to their involvement in various scandals.
 
 
 
• **Feeling of brotherhood **(भाईचारे की भावना): Refers to a sense of ***camaraderie and mutual support ***among individuals.
 
 
• **Example:** The ***feeling of brotherhood*** among the team members was evident during the crisis.
